name.es: All Tomorrows: los mundos de los Qu

facts.claim: K-type main-sequence star artificially enriched in chromospheric activity and magnetic pumping by Qu stellar-engineering.
facts.justification: The lore describes a 'monstrous sun' driven by flare/UV output rather than a spectral class shift; K-dwarfs with enhanced magnetic activity fit the book's description without violating hydrostatic equilibrium. Core metallicity splicing replaced with forced rotation/magnetic pumping; chromospheric engineering marked highly speculative. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Elevated UV-C flux selects for subterranean refuge and dermal radiation shielding.
Chromospheric flares drive periodic surface sterilization cycles.

facts.claim: Controlled stellar dimming phase over millennia, reducing luminosity by ~12% and triggering surface die-offs that forced underground refuge.
facts.justification: The lore describes the sun cooling, leading to the Worms' subterranean adaptation and eventual surface re-expansion as the Snake People. Explicit Qu stellar dimming tech, not natural evolution. (given by the lore / inferred mechanism)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Estivation and torpor cycles evolve to survive prolonged cold/dark.
Surface re-colonization drives serpentine, agoraphobic morphologies.

facts.claim: 36-hour solar day engineered via tidal spin-orbit coupling and orbital damping to extend daylight for surface terraforming.
facts.justification: The lore requires extended daylight for Qu engineering; tidal locking adjustments and orbital damping are standard planetary engineering concepts. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Extended photoperiods synchronize breeding and foraging with artificial diurnal cycles.
Slower rotation reduces Coriolis forces, simplifying global wind patterns.

facts.claim: 1.22 g surface gravity maintained by Qu mass-dumping and modest radius compression.
facts.justification: Higher gravity selects for low center-of-mass architecture and distributed load-bearing, explaining the prevalence of tripedal and sprawling indigenous morphologies. Crustal thickening alone barely changes g; total mass increase is required. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: High g favors low-profile, stable stances over upright bipedalism.
Increased skeletal density and hydrostatic leverage are required for locomotion.

facts.claim: Indigenous fauna exhibit tripedal symmetry, hydrostatic/hydrostatic-assisted musculature, and low center-of-gravity architecture optimized for 1.22 g.
facts.justification: Lore/given for Panderavis contrast; tripedal stance and hydrostatic support distribute load efficiently under moderate-high gravity without requiring massive skeletal density. (given by the lore)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Low CoG prevents tipping on soft, crystalline substrates.
Hydrostatic networks allow flexible limb articulation without heavy joints.

facts.claim: 1.8 bar total surface pressure, N₂-CO₂ mix with suspended silicate aerosols and trace noble gases.
facts.justification: Dense atmosphere raises acoustic impedance and slows convective mixing, creating stable thermal inversions and persistent ground fog. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: High pressure improves aerodynamic lift for gliding morphologies.
Dense air efficiently transmits low-frequency sound over kilometers.

facts.claim: Amber twilight and persistent ground fog due to aerosol Mie reddening and optical depth, suppressing blue light.
facts.justification: Silicate dust and high CO₂ shift the visible spectrum toward red/amber via Mie scattering, extending low-contrast daylight and reducing UV penetration to the surface. Rayleigh mechanism replaced with aerosol Mie reddening. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Visual predators evolve tapetum lucidum and thermal pit organs.
Photosynthetic organisms shift pigments to capture near-infrared flux.

facts.claim: High atmospheric density triples acoustic impedance, favoring low-frequency vocalizations and ground-coupled seismic communication over long distances.
facts.justification: Dense, particulate-laden air scatters high frequencies but transmits infrasound efficiently, matching the lore's emphasis on vibrational ground-music and acoustic waveguides. Adjusted multiplier to ~1.4 for 1.8 bar. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Herds coordinate via chest-rumbling hums and ground taps.
High-pitch whistles cause disorientation and break formation.

facts.claim: 42 µT planetary magnetic field guiding magnetoreceptive navigation but creating blind spots near Qu basalt foundations.
facts.justification: A terrestrial-grade dynamo field is plausible for a super-Earth; engineered basalt creates localized magnetic anomalies that disrupt biological compasses. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Subterranean fauna use magnetite-based navigation for tunnel mapping.
Qu ruins act as magnetic dead zones, forcing sensory reliance on vibration.

facts.claim: Kilometric stone pyramids and glass-melt plains dominate topography, channeling katabatic winds and creating localized wind-tunnel acoustics.
facts.justification: The lore explicitly describes Qu-engineered pyramids and recarved surfaces; geometric structures naturally funnel wind and sound. (given by the lore)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Venturi-adapted hollow bones exploit pyramid updrafts for silent descent.
Wind-tunnel architecture creates standing waves for long-distance acoustic communication.

facts.claim: Shallow, hypersaline seas laced with geothermal copper, zinc, and sulfur runoff, supporting chemosynthetic filter mats.
facts.justification: Qu terraforming diverted or evaporated original oceans; geothermal vents leach heavy metals, creating metal-rich brine pools. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Filter-feeding colonies evolve into living mats that strip toxins.
Shallow seas concentrate metal ions, driving copper-based respiratory evolution.

facts.claim: Chitinous-metal composite biomineralization in skeletal structures and hydrostatic muscle networks, integrating low-% structural copper salts and iron co-mineralization.
facts.justification: Copper bioavailability allows heavy structural integration, but requires strict chelation to prevent neurotoxicity; matches the lore's native fauna description. Replaced 15 wt% toxic bone with low-% chitinous-metal composite; iron added for magnetic sensitivity. (given by the lore / inferred mechanism)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: High mass/inertia slows acceleration but increases blunt-force resistance.
Magnetic fields disrupt gait and cause tremors in iron-copper mineralized lineages.

facts.claim: Tectonic recycling halted by Qu dampening rigs, leaving ancient urban foundations and glass plains exposed to slow aeolian weathering.
facts.justification: The lore describes dead cities and recarved surfaces; engineered seismic dampening would preserve ruins over 40 million years. Zero plate recycling still allows aeolian/chemical weathering. (given by the lore / inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Surface litter includes weathered Qu polymers and silicate composites.
Predictable fault lines concentrate geothermal heat near ruins.

facts.claim: 20°C diurnal temperature swings dampened by atmospheric heat capacity, but high UV/X-ray flare flux drives surface sterilization.
facts.justification: High atmospheric density buffers temperature, yet stellar flares deliver lethal radiation pulses, forcing life into refugia or armored states. Ozone/magnetic screening modulates flare lethality; copper-oxide dermal plating replaced with melanin/carotenoid shielding + underground refugia. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Organisms develop melanin-carotenoid dermal plating and retinal-shift pigments.
Surface activity concentrates in crepuscular windows between flare events.

facts.claim: Hemocyanin-like oxygen transport systems selected for copper-rich aquatic/soil chemistry, trading high affinity for cold-tolerant reversibility.
facts.justification: Copper-based respiratory pigments scale with atmospheric density and soil copper loads; lower affinity at high pH is offset by high ambient O₂. Clarified 21% as mole fraction at 1.8 bar (~0.38 bar PO₂). (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Slow metabolic rate and high stamina favor ambush predation.
Activity drops sharply below 10°C due to hemocyanin kinetics.

facts.claim: Dormant Qu nanite lattices integrated into soil and cell membranes, acting as catalytic bridges for rapid tissue turnover and metal chelation.
facts.justification: The lore describes Qu genetic/nanotech legacy persisting post-departure; engineered nanites would act as metabolic catalysts in a terraformed biosphere. Patchy distribution and defined decay half-life prevent uniform magic soil. (given by the lore)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Symbiotic organisms gain accelerated repair and toxin sequestration.
Nanite decay creates inert silicon-glass dust that disrupts nerve conduction.

facts.claim: Panderavis pandora fossil retains terrestrial calcium-phosphate bones and four-limbed vertebrate anatomy, marking it as an out-of-place Earth transplant.
facts.justification: The lore explicitly identifies the Panderavis as a therizinosaur lineage from Earth, contrasting sharply with the native three-limbed, copper-boned fauna. (given by the lore)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Calcium-based skeleton limits size in high-Cu, high-g environments.
Four-limbed posture is maladaptive on soft, crystalline substrates.

facts.claim: Chemolithotrophic gut symbionts and silicon-iron matrix flora enable energy extraction from abrasive, metal-laden substrates and crystalline biomass.
facts.justification: Crystalline 'plants' recycle oxygen but are chemically inert to conventional digestion; symbionts secrete chelating enzymes and grinding structures. Energy derived from organics/symbiont metabolites, not silicon lattice bond energy. (inferred)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Detritivores evolve multi-chambered guts to process silica and metals.
Metal-sifting behavior neutralizes nanite residue and recovers nutrients.

facts.claim: Copper-sulfur clusters in neural tissue and spirally coiled ganglia adapt to hypoxic, high-metal underground niches, enabling parallel spatial processing.
facts.justification: The lore describes Snake People with spirally coiled brains and agoraphobic tendencies; copper-based redox reactions support rapid neural processing in low-oxygen environments. Marked Cu-S neural enhancement as highly speculative; artifact 'power-ups' moved to gameplay. (given by the lore / inferred mechanism)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Spiral ganglia allow parallel processing of 3D spatial maps.
High metal tolerance enables consumption of Qu artifacts for power-ups.

facts.claim: Composite world model integrating worm, colonial, ruin-haunter, killer-folk, and Panderavis environments into a single playable setting.
facts.justification: The LORE TEXT actually describes multiple Qu worlds; treating F1–F20 as one playable composite avoids false global predictions while preserving narrative scope. (given by the lore)

provenance.council: planet drafts + peer reviews + astrobio referee, merged by the chair (deepseek skeptic)

consequences: Environmental gradients allow rapid biome shifts over short distances.
Player adaptations must account for localized Qu engineering variations.
